notes.title: The BIGGEST Update So Far !
notes.content:
This is the biggest update [i]Destroy Them[/i] has received.

There are a [b]ton[/b] of patches for a lot of bugs, a new user interface, new menus and more !

The new menu : [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/34d139c424a4108b39ca1166d8d5a7b1f440315a.png[/img]

The new HUD : [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/0ec21cdfec8dbe008d5c75b2a9c4d18aedca9fb0.png[/img]

All the fixes : 
-Improved menus
-Now show remaining bullet like this: 24/40 instead of 24/Infinite
-New logo for the game
-Replaced some texts "like press E to dash" by icons (UI improvement)
-Improved footsteps noise
-Blackened the vignetting effect when taking damage
-Added a sound when you die and improved the "dying" interface
-The robots always follow you now, they will not stop if you jump too high anymore

[previewyoutube=TpnZKs9b7S8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Destroy Them will become Free2Play !
notes.content:
Destroy Them will soon become Free2Play, so don't buy the game during the price change process:-)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/c9688110d93eef5a1346158b836f170f69a95e04.png[/img]

notes.title: The Font Update !
notes.content:
In this update, the [u][b]Font[/b][/u] has been updated on most of the UI to make it look better !

[i]The Menu[/i] Before and After : 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/eb0ed86acacff0f228db1dcf9f6103ddab2a3e9b.jpg[/img]

[i]In Game[/i] Before and After :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/d7f8016114ae3a234dac1cecb87d6465ce8d0243.jpg[/img]

There are also [b][u]bug fixes[/u][/b], an [u][b]improvement[/b][/u] to the death screen and much more !

notes.title: Découvrez la nouvelle map : Containight !
notes.content:
With this [u][b]New Update[/b][/u], you will be able to play on a brand new map: [b][u][i]Containight[/i][/u][/b] !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923527/6e5038ee041c54bdb1a6bab82f905c66df398b23.png[/img]

This update also contains [b][u]a major improvement[/u][/b] to the feeling the player has when taking damage, it will now be much easier to notice that a robot is attacking you : 
[i]-The edges of the screen will turn black
-and the volume of the damage sound has been increased.[/i]

There are also [i]bug fixes[/i], [i]interface improvements[/i] and much more!

notes.title: Discover the new major update of Destroy Them !
notes.content:
With this [b]New Update[/b], you'll be able to play with a new exciting weapon : [u][b]the submachine gun[/b][/u] !
You can now switch guns during the game and you can use the other weapon when one is empty ! 
There is also a new [i][u][b]hidden[/b][/u][/i] map for you to discover, bringing the total amount of maps to 5 !
[previewyoutube=uPwKVXww6Os;full][/previewyoutube]
If you have any [u][b]feedback[/b][/u] to give, don't hesitate, I'm open to any suggestions :-)
